title: Puppet Master Project System contracts
description: Closed Project aggregate, lifecycle action, exact caller-return, result, and migration receipt contracts.

caller close or navigation does not cancel a dispatched owner operation

verified_repository_identity.description: Verified remote repository identity from a terminal Forge/SCM create result. Never inferred from remote text, never speculative, and present only when the remote effect state is verified_created.

available.description: Effective dispatch availability: eligibility plus current permission, a live recovery claim, and central registration, wiring, and native handler gates. A verified created remote alone never forces true.

resume_eligible.description: Owner resume eligibility: the retained joins hold for a verified created remote with a current reviewed draft, a current composition, disjoint settled/remaining sets, and no fencing conflict.

delete_repository.description: Project System never dispatches repository deletion; Delete Repository is consumed from the Forge FGI-021 cmd.forge.repository.delete admission with its exact currentness and target-bound confirmation, and stays unavailable in Project scope with forge_owner_gated until the Forge owner proves its own dispatch gates. Never Project-local, never automatic rollback.

recovery_route_availability.description: Project-owned per-route availability with fail-closed reasons. Central registration, wiring, and handler availability gate actual dispatch separately.

original_command_id.description: Only an original action with an exact currently owned receipted remote-create chain anchors a remote-create recovery. cmd.project.new_local never qualifies; cmd.project.add_existing qualifies only when such a chain is defined for it.

original_terminal_result_ref.description: Immutable ref to the original rejected terminal ProjectActionResult. Restart and replay return this result; they never infer a new effect.

original_terminal_result_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the immutable original result encoded as RFC 8785 canonical JSON (CV-333), resolved by original_terminal_result_ref. Any canonical payload difference fails closed; fixture checks use the existing integer/string-only oracle.

settled_effects.description: Settled creation steps keyed by effect. Object keys make a duplicate settled effect unrepresentable.

active_resume_claim.description: One-active-resume claim admitted by atomic compare-and-swap. Null when no attempt is active; a second new attempt is rejected or coalesced while a claim is held.

project_creation_recovery_context.description: Restart-safe retained Project creation recovery under SP-321 custody. Replaying the original idempotency key re-observes the terminal result and never resumes; only cmd.project.resume_creation with a creation_recovery_resume_binding advances, and only from verified_created with owner-resolved joins.

recovery_composition_revision.description: Candidate composition revision the owner compares against the retained composition_revision. A stale revision fails closed.

original_command_id.description: Only an original action with an exact currently owned receipted remote-create chain anchors a remote-create recovery. cmd.project.new_local never qualifies; cmd.project.add_existing qualifies only when such a chain is defined for it.

join_checks.description: Owner-computed echo recorded after server-side resolution. Each flag reads true only on an owner-verified join, but client-supplied values grant no authority: the semantic validator ignores these booleans and compares actual retained fields, and any mismatch fails closed even when every flag reads true.

creation_recovery_resume_binding.description: Typed resume join carried by cmd.project.resume_creation. Binds the fresh attempt to the original operation, the exact reviewed draft, and the verified Forge create result; resumes only remaining effects. Authority comes only from owner-resolved comparison typed as creation_recovery_resume_round_trip, never from the join_checks echo.

attempt_command_instance_id.description: Resume-namespaced command instance holding the claim.

attempt_idempotency_key.description: Resume-namespaced idempotency key holding the claim.

claim_generation.description: Fresh generation admitted with the winning attempt. Child effects and result adoption are fenced by this generation and attempt identity.

creation_recovery_resume_claim.description: One-active-resume claim admitted by atomic compare-and-swap on the retained recovery. Exactly one attempt holds it per recovery.

retained_context.description: Owner-resolved retained recovery as held under SP-321 custody.

candidate_request.description: Candidate cmd.project.resume_creation request whose binding the owner compares against the retained context.

original_terminal_result.description: Immutable original rejected terminal result of the creation. Restart and replay return these bytes.

accepted.description: True only when the semantic comparison yields no failure.

creation_recovery_resume_round_trip.description: Paired resume evidence: the owner-resolved retained context, the candidate resume request, and the original terminal result together so the central semantic validator can compare actual fields. Client join_checks values are ignored for authority in every comparison.
x-semantic-invariants: retained_context.reviewed_setup_binding == candidate_request.creation_recovery_resume_binding.reviewed_setup_binding (deep equality over the entire binding)
join_checks values are ignored for authority in every comparison

Resolve original_terminal_result by retained_context.original_terminal_result_ref; SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON of that resolved result == retained_context.original_terminal_result_sha256 (CV-333). Static fixture comparisons use the existing integer/string-only canonical owner-result oracle.
A self-claim matches both attempt_command_instance_id and attempt_idempotency_key to the candidate request; matching only one is a concurrent active attempt.

project_setup_commit_binding.description: Project-owned read model binding an actual typed Project action result, listing and required child receipts to the one confirmed setup. A schema-valid value is not authenticated owner verification, and no new physical receipt family is admitted.
